name: City of Stories: Stephan's Journey Collector's Edition
detailed_description:
Grandma Studios Limited presents a new direction for storytelling in the Hidden Object genre with City of Stories: Stephan’s Journey!

Stephan is a young man on a modest family farm in England’s countryside during the Tudor period. When a few bad harvests put the farm dangerously behind on bills and taxes, Stephan makes a difficult decision to say goodbye to his family and journey to the city to make a name for himself, forge a career, and make enough money to save his family!

Chapter by chapter and scene by scene, you make the choices that determine how Stephan’s story unfolds! But choose carefully because not everyone he meets has his best interests in mind. Fortunately, you can replay previous chapters to rewrite the story and pursue a different path. Will Stephan become a guard, a dockhand, a merchant, or something completely different? Experience the excitement and fear of a young man setting out into a bigger world on his own for the first time, and earn enough money to buy upgrades and save the family farm in this brand-new story-driven Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure game!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version.

The Collector's Edition includes:

  • Join the adventures of a young orphan in the Bonus Chapter!

  • Write your favorite story with a strategy guide!

  • Replay your favorite mini-games and enjoy unlimited Match-3!

  • Find collectible cards and earn coins to upgrade your farmhouse!

  • Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, music, videos, and concept art!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.
